en.title: Sol's RNG
en.description: Roll for rare auras, craft equipment, and use potions to improve your luck.
tips: Save your best potions for longer rolling sessions.
Craft equipment that increases your luck.
Check crafting requirements before discarding an aura.

redeem.title: How to redeem codes in Sol's RNG
redeem.description: Follow these steps to redeem codes in Sol's RNG.
steps: Click Open next to Redeem Code.
Enter a code and press Redeem.

redeem.title: Como resgatar códigos em Sol's RNG
redeem.description: Siga estas etapas para resgatar códigos em Sol's RNG.

Digite o código e pressione Redeem.
